timing_boundary.GTSAM_start: Assembled factors, before solver construction; the worker watchdog starts at the same boundary
timing_boundary.GTSAM_excluded: Matrix-to-factor translation and input-only row-origin bookkeeping; recorded separately
timing_boundary.GTSAM_included: Solver construction, Dense packing, ordering, feasibility, initialization, optimization, multiplier recovery, output conversion and return cleanup
timing_boundary.GTSAM_representation: WALK/BAL: one control-sequence vector key and one objective factor. QUAD: 12D state and four 3D force keys per step, with 12-row dynamics factors; original scalar row identities preserved.
timing_boundary.baseline_start: Existing upstream qpsolvers matrix-input boundaries, unchanged
timing_boundary.dual_initialization: Zero multipliers; no primal feasibility phase

dense_cholesky.scope: Positive-definite Hessian-only Dense objectives with no equalities; both formulations. Native H is checked before adding regularization. LLT success and rcond(H)>sqrt(machine epsilon) select Cholesky; all other cases keep the existing square-root path.
dense_cholesky.timing: Two persistent fresh-solver workers load the preserved baseline and new library. Every repeat interleaves cases, settings, formulations and versions in a seeded random order; one core/TBB/numerical thread. Factor construction and independent scoring excluded. First call plus five fresh repetitions per combination.

automatic_selection.cold_start: Dual with inequalities, regardless of counts
automatic_selection.warm_start: Retain a converged resolved formulation when supplied values are feasible
automatic_selection.direct_primal: No inequalities or zero reduced dimension
automatic_selection.curvature_fallback: Primal when reduced curvature is singular with zero regularization; no added floor
automatic_selection.lp: Automatic resolves to Primal; Dual rejected

dense_dual_whitening.scope: Selected seven MPC cases only; historical 64-case and G1 measurements retained
dense_dual_whitening.timing: The paired campaign contains 1,512 GTSAM calls: 21 problem/accuracy combinations, both libraries, two Dense equality settings plus Sparse, and one initial call plus eleven fresh repetitions. A separate 756-call diagnostic campaign uses one initial call plus five repetitions. DAQP has 252 calls, with the same twelve-call schedule per problem/accuracy. Runs are serial on CPU 0 with one numerical-library thread and one TBB thread; both GTSAM libraries and DAQP are interleaved in a randomized order with seed 749. GTSAM timing starts with assembled native factors and includes solver construction, packing, equality handling, transformation, optimization, certification, multiplier recovery and output conversion. DAQP starts with prepacked native arrays and includes its fresh setup and solve. Independent scoring is outside both clocks.
dense_dual_whitening.scoring: Every returned solution is rescored against the original matrices for primal feasibility, stationarity, nonnegative mathematical inequality multipliers and absolute duality gap. The selected campaign uses explicit 1e-6 and 1e-9 tolerances; Default keeps native stopping settings but is rescored at 1e-6. This stricter Default check differs from the historical full-suite profile below, whose published Default threshold is 1.0. No DAQP proximal settings are retuned. All 1,512 GTSAM calls and all 756 diagnostic calls pass. DAQP passes the four small cases and fails the original gap checks on all three larger cases at all three settings; its returned success flag is recorded but does not override those failures.
